units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|Shortly after you disembark the <ship> for the spaceport on <origin>, you hear a quiet but noticeable clattering from behind you near where your ship is being refueled.|155|0
units.english: Shortly after you disembark the <ship> for the spaceport on <origin>, you hear a quiet but noticeable clattering from behind you near where your ship is being refueled.
units.italian: Poco dopo che siete scesi dalla <ship> per lo spazioporto di <origin>, sentite un tintinnio sommesso ma ben distinguibile alle vostre spalle, vicino al punto in cui la vostra nave sta facendo rifornimento.

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	(Investigate the sound.)|157|0
units.english: (Investigate the sound.)
units.italian: (Vai a vedere da dove viene.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	(Ignore it.)|158|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignora il rumore.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	Upon approaching the source of the clattering, you catch a trio of Successors in the process of smearing the hull of the <ship> with globs of a colorful, foul-smelling solution. It is so pungent you can barely approach them without retching, but the Successors seem not to notice, or not to care.|160|0
units.english: Upon approaching the source of the clattering, you catch a trio of Successors in the process of smearing the hull of the <ship> with globs of a colorful, foul-smelling solution. It is so pungent you can barely approach them without retching, but the Successors seem not to notice, or not to care.
units.italian: Avvicinandovi alla fonte del tintinnio, sorprendete tre Successori mentre spalmano lo scafo della <ship> con grumi di una soluzione colorata e maleodorante. La puzza è così acre che riuscite a stento ad avvicinarvi senza conati, ma i Successori sembrano non accorgersene, o non interessarsene.

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"What are you doing to my ship?"|162|0
units.english: "What are you doing to my ship?"
units.italian: "Che cosa state facendo alla mia nave?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"Excuse me, are you all part of the repair crew?"|164|0
units.english: "Excuse me, are you all part of the repair crew?"
units.italian: "Scusate, fate tutti parte della squadra di riparazione?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	The three Successors startle at the sound of your voice, arms whipping around as they turn to face you. One makes a move to run away, but one of the others clamps onto their arm and reels them back alongside them. All three slowly turn a shade of dull purple and their skin seems to contract over the underlying musculature. One of them eventually replies. "Yes, correct thou art! We've orders to apply this ... hull solution to repair a spot of damage here."|165|0
units.english: The three Successors startle at the sound of your voice, arms whipping around as they turn to face you. One makes a move to run away, but one of the others clamps onto their arm and reels them back alongside them. All three slowly turn a shade of dull purple and their skin seems to contract over the underlying musculature. One of them eventually replies. "Yes, correct thou art! We've orders to apply this ... hull solution to repair a spot of damage here."
units.italian: I tre Successori trasaliscono al suono della vostra voce, le braccia che scattano mentre si voltano verso di voi. Uno accenna a fuggire, ma uno degli altri gli si aggrappa al braccio e lo riporta indietro al loro fianco. Tutti e tre assumono lentamente una tonalità di viola spento e la loro pelle sembra contrarsi sopra la muscolatura sottostante. Alla fine uno di loro risponde. "Sì, hai ragione tu! Abbiamo l'ordine di applicare questa ... soluzione per lo scafo, per riparare un punto danneggiato qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	Waves of color run up the bodies of the others, and the tips of their arms undulate gently.|166|0
units.english: Waves of color run up the bodies of the others, and the tips of their arms undulate gently.
units.italian: Ondate di colore risalgono lungo i corpi degli altri, e le punte delle loro braccia ondeggiano piano.

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"I've never seen a solution like that before. How does it work?"|168|0
units.english: "I've never seen a solution like that before. How does it work?"
units.italian: "Non avevo mai visto una soluzione del genere. Come funziona?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"I'm sorry to interrupt in that case. Carry on."|170|0
units.english: "I'm sorry to interrupt in that case. Carry on."
units.italian: "In tal caso mi scuso per l'interruzione. Continuate."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	The three Successors startle at the sound of your voice, their arms whipping around as they turn to face you. One makes a move to run away, but one of the others clamps onto their arm and reels them back alongside them. All three slowly turn a shade of dull purple and their skin seems to contract over the underlying musculature. One of them eventually replies. "We... ah... we're part of the repair crew! We've orders to apply this... hull solution to repair a spot of damage here."|173|0
units.english: The three Successors startle at the sound of your voice, their arms whipping around as they turn to face you. One makes a move to run away, but one of the others clamps onto their arm and reels them back alongside them. All three slowly turn a shade of dull purple and their skin seems to contract over the underlying musculature. One of them eventually replies. "We... ah... we're part of the repair crew! We've orders to apply this... hull solution to repair a spot of damage here."
units.italian: I tre Successori trasaliscono al suono della vostra voce, le braccia che scattano mentre si voltano verso di voi. Uno accenna a fuggire, ma uno degli altri gli si aggrappa al braccio e lo riporta indietro al loro fianco. Tutti e tre assumono lentamente una tonalità di viola spento e la loro pelle sembra contrarsi sopra la muscolatura sottostante. Alla fine uno di loro risponde. "Noi... ah... facciamo parte della squadra di riparazione! Abbiamo l'ordine di applicare questa... soluzione per lo scafo, per riparare un punto danneggiato qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	Waves of color run up the bodies of the others, and the tips of their arms undulate gently.|174|0
units.english: Waves of color run up the bodies of the others, and the tips of their arms undulate gently.
units.italian: Ondate di colore risalgono lungo i corpi degli altri, e le punte delle loro braccia ondeggiano piano.

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"I've never seen a solution like that before. How does it work?"|176|0
units.english: "I've never seen a solution like that before. How does it work?"
units.italian: "Non avevo mai visto una soluzione del genere. Come funziona?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"I'm sorry to interrupt in that case. Carry on."|178|0
units.english: "I'm sorry to interrupt in that case. Carry on."
units.italian: "In tal caso mi scuso per l'interruzione. Continuate."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	The group look around at each other before the same one replies again. "The... ah... solution seeps into the cracks and strains within the hull and when it dries it seals them. Beyond that, we do not know; we just apply it as directed by the port authority."|181|0
units.english: The group look around at each other before the same one replies again. "The... ah... solution seeps into the cracks and strains within the hull and when it dries it seals them. Beyond that, we do not know; we just apply it as directed by the port authority."
units.italian: Il gruppo si scambia sguardi prima che lo stesso Successore risponda di nuovo. "La... ah... soluzione penetra nelle crepe e nelle fessure dello scafo e, quando si asciuga, le sigilla. Oltre a questo non sappiamo nulla; la applichiamo solo come ci dice l'autorità portuale."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	One of the other ones pipes up, cheerfully adding, "We don't know anything!" before the others give them a dark look.|182|0
units.english: One of the other ones pipes up, cheerfully adding, "We don't know anything!" before the others give them a dark look.
units.italian: Uno degli altri interviene, aggiungendo allegramente: "Noi non sappiamo niente!" e gli altri lo fulminano con lo sguardo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"And it's so colorful too! Are you sure it's not a paint of some sort?"|184|0
units.english: "And it's so colorful too! Are you sure it's not a paint of some sort?"
units.italian: "Ed è anche così colorata! Siete sicuri che non sia una specie di vernice?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"Fascinating. Carry on."|185|0
units.english: "Fascinating. Carry on."
units.italian: "Affascinante. Continuate."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"Oh, that's for... ah... safety. Yes, 'tis very dangerous to touch if thou'r'nt trained, so 'tis bright in color as a warning." None of the three are wearing any sort of protective equipment that you can see, and by now most of the group have changed color to what you might characterize as a mirthful shade of pink. This is something which one or two are clearly trying to suppress, their skin shifting in gradients in an effort to maintain their previous dull purple hue. One of the others is trying to hide a bag filled with more cans of "hull solution" behind their arms.|187|0
units.english: "Oh, that's for... ah... safety. Yes, 'tis very dangerous to touch if thou'r'nt trained, so 'tis bright in color as a warning." None of the three are wearing any sort of protective equipment that you can see, and by now most of the group have changed color to what you might characterize as a mirthful shade of pink. This is something which one or two are clearly trying to suppress, their skin shifting in gradients in an effort to maintain their previous dull purple hue. One of the others is trying to hide a bag filled with more cans of "hull solution" behind their arms.
units.italian: "Oh, è per... ah... la sicurezza. Sì, è molto pericoloso toccarla se non sei addestrato, per questo è di un colore così acceso, come avvertimento." Nessuno dei tre indossa alcun tipo di equipaggiamento protettivo, per quanto possiate vedere, e ormai gran parte del gruppo ha cambiato colore assumendo quella che potreste definire una tonalità di rosa divertita. È qualcosa che uno o due stanno chiaramente cercando di reprimere, la pelle che sfuma in gradienti nel tentativo di mantenere la precedente tinta viola spenta. Uno degli altri cerca di nascondere dietro le braccia una borsa piena di altre lattine di "soluzione per lo scafo".

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"Well, if you're working on behalf of the port, then surely I can ask you to remove it as well."|189|0
units.english: "Well, if you're working on behalf of the port, then surely I can ask you to remove it as well."
units.italian: "Beh, se lavorate per conto dello spazioporto, allora posso certo chiedervi di toglierla."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"Nice try, but you and I both know what's going on here."|190|0
units.english: "Nice try, but you and I both know what's going on here."
units.italian: "Bel tentativo, ma io e te sappiamo entrambi che cosa sta succedendo qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"I think my ship's hull has been well enough repaired. It might be best for you to attend to whatever other vessels are on your list."|191|0
units.english: "I think my ship's hull has been well enough repaired. It might be best for you to attend to whatever other vessels are on your list."
units.italian: "Credo che lo scafo della mia nave sia stato riparato abbastanza. Forse è meglio che vi occupiate delle altre navi che avete in lista."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	"Thanks for answering my questions. Please carry on."|193|0
units.english: "Thanks for answering my questions. Please carry on."
units.italian: "Grazie per aver risposto alle mie domande. Continuate pure."

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	The trio seem rather deflated at hearing this, but after quite a bit of milling amongst themselves eventually relent and agree to remove the solution so long as you don't inform the port authority about their actions. While they put good effort into removing it - or at least act the part - they can't seem to scrub away the most dried-on parts, and you eventually let them go after it becomes apparent that some of the paint has permanently bonded to the hull.|195|0
units.english: The trio seem rather deflated at hearing this, but after quite a bit of milling amongst themselves eventually relent and agree to remove the solution so long as you don't inform the port authority about their actions. While they put good effort into removing it - or at least act the part - they can't seem to scrub away the most dried-on parts, and you eventually let them go after it becomes apparent that some of the paint has permanently bonded to the hull.
units.italian: Il terzetto sembra piuttosto abbattuto all'udire queste parole, ma dopo un bel po' di conciliaboli fra loro alla fine cedono e accettano di togliere la soluzione, purché non informiate l'autorità portuale di ciò che hanno fatto. Si danno da fare per rimuoverla, o almeno recitano la parte, ma non riescono a strofinare via le parti più secche, e alla fine li lasciate andare quando diventa evidente che una parte della vernice si è legata allo scafo in modo permanente.

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	The trio brighten up at hearing this, and after some milling amongst themselves eventually glide off into the spaceport with their cans of solution in tow, though not before leaving one with you for "emergency repairs," though considering how terrible it smells it's not certain if you could ever stand trying to apply it.|198|0
units.english: The trio brighten up at hearing this, and after some milling amongst themselves eventually glide off into the spaceport with their cans of solution in tow, though not before leaving one with you for "emergency repairs," though considering how terrible it smells it's not certain if you could ever stand trying to apply it.
units.italian: Il terzetto si rallegra all'udire queste parole e, dopo qualche conciliabolo, scivola via nello spazioporto trascinandosi le lattine di soluzione, non prima però di lasciarne una a voi per le "riparazioni d'emergenza"; considerando però quanto puzza, non è certo che riuscireste mai a sopportare di applicarla.

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	Upon returning from the spaceport some time later, you find that an area on the side of the <ship> has been covered in a thick, colorful solution with an incredibly noxious smell so potent you can hardly bear to approach it. The pattern forms some words in the Successor script, and while the translation device struggles to interpret the non-standard glyphs, it eventually offers a translation along the lines of "Ryiaa was here! And friends." The defacement takes several hours for the spaceport crews to sufficiently scour off, but a small degree of discoloration remains permanently bonded to the hull plating for the foreseeable future.|201|0
units.english: Upon returning from the spaceport some time later, you find that an area on the side of the <ship> has been covered in a thick, colorful solution with an incredibly noxious smell so potent you can hardly bear to approach it. The pattern forms some words in the Successor script, and while the translation device struggles to interpret the non-standard glyphs, it eventually offers a translation along the lines of "Ryiaa was here! And friends." The defacement takes several hours for the spaceport crews to sufficiently scour off, but a small degree of discoloration remains permanently bonded to the hull plating for the foreseeable future.
units.italian: Al vostro ritorno dallo spazioporto, qualche tempo dopo, trovate una zona sul fianco della <ship> ricoperta di una spessa soluzione colorata dal puzzo incredibilmente acre, così forte che riuscite a malapena ad avvicinarvi. Il disegno forma alcune parole nella scrittura dei Successori e, sebbene il dispositivo di traduzione fatichi a interpretare quei glifi non standard, alla fine propone una traduzione più o meno così: "Ryiaa è stata qui! Con gli amici." I tecnici dello spazioporto impiegano diverse ore per raschiarla via del tutto, ma una lieve alterazione del colore resta legata in modo permanente alle lastre dello scafo, per molto tempo a venire.

units.id: mission:Successors: Graffiti|	Upon returning from the spaceport some time later, you find that the "repair crew" has covered an area on the side of the <ship> in their colorful and noxious solution. The pattern forms some words in the Successor script placed alongside a rather crude depiction of your face. The translation device struggles to interpret the non-standard glyphs, but it eventually resolves the text as "'Erjn'-Fool! No quills, no brain!" The defacement takes several hours for the spaceport crews to sufficiently scour off, but a small degree of discoloration remains permanently bonded to the hull plating for the foreseeable future.|204|0
units.english: Upon returning from the spaceport some time later, you find that the "repair crew" has covered an area on the side of the <ship> in their colorful and noxious solution. The pattern forms some words in the Successor script placed alongside a rather crude depiction of your face. The translation device struggles to interpret the non-standard glyphs, but it eventually resolves the text as "'Erjn'-Fool! No quills, no brain!" The defacement takes several hours for the spaceport crews to sufficiently scour off, but a small degree of discoloration remains permanently bonded to the hull plating for the foreseeable future.
units.italian: Al vostro ritorno dallo spazioporto, qualche tempo dopo, trovate che la "squadra di riparazione" ha ricoperto una zona sul fianco della <ship> con la sua soluzione colorata e puzzolente. Il disegno forma alcune parole nella scrittura dei Successori, accanto a una raffigurazione alquanto grossolana del vostro volto. Il dispositivo di traduzione fatica a interpretare quei glifi non standard, ma alla fine decifra il testo come "'Erjn'... Stupido! Niente aculei, niente cervello!" I tecnici dello spazioporto impiegano diverse ore per raschiarla via del tutto, ma una lieve alterazione del colore resta legata in modo permanente alle lastre dello scafo, per molto tempo a venire.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|Walking through the spaceport, you notice several posters have been put up to advertise some sort of performance, each one showing an outstretched Successor standing atop a brilliant blue sphere that swirls with octopoid forms. "Deathless Myiara," reads the title.|219|0
units.english: Walking through the spaceport, you notice several posters have been put up to advertise some sort of performance, each one showing an outstretched Successor standing atop a brilliant blue sphere that swirls with octopoid forms. "Deathless Myiara," reads the title.
units.italian: Attraversando lo spazioporto, notate diversi manifesti affissi per pubblicizzare una specie di spettacolo, ognuno dei quali mostra un Successore con le braccia aperte in piedi su una sfera di un blu brillante in cui si agitano forme di polpo. "Myiara l'Immortale", recita il titolo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|label|221|0
units.english: myiara system
units.italian: myiara system

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|Walking through the spaceport, you notice several posters have been put up to advertise some sort of performance, each one showing an outstretched Successor standing atop a brilliant blue sphere that swirls with octopoid forms. "Deathless Myiara," reads the title, the last word echoing the name of this star system.|222|0
units.english: Walking through the spaceport, you notice several posters have been put up to advertise some sort of performance, each one showing an outstretched Successor standing atop a brilliant blue sphere that swirls with octopoid forms. "Deathless Myiara," reads the title, the last word echoing the name of this star system.
units.italian: Attraversando lo spazioporto, notate diversi manifesti affissi per pubblicizzare una specie di spettacolo, ognuno dei quali mostra un Successore con le braccia aperte in piedi su una sfera di un blu brillante in cui si agitano forme di polpo. "Myiara l'Immortale", recita il titolo, e l'ultima parola riecheggia il nome di questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	As you look at the poster, a passing Successor takes notice and greets you, splaying their arms in the traditional manner. "The honored alien!" they say. "Doth the play arouse tonight thy interest? 'Tis a good company that puts it on."|224|0
units.english: As you look at the poster, a passing Successor takes notice and greets you, splaying their arms in the traditional manner. "The honored alien!" they say. "Doth the play arouse tonight thy interest? 'Tis a good company that puts it on."
units.italian: Mentre guardate il manifesto, un Successore di passaggio vi nota e vi saluta, aprendo le braccia nel modo tradizionale. "L'alieno onorato!" dice. "Lo spettacolo stasera desta il tuo interesse? È una buona compagnia quella che lo mette in scena."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	"Why not? Can you show me where it is?"|226|0
units.english: "Why not? Can you show me where it is?"
units.italian: "Perché no? Puoi mostrarmi dove si tiene?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	"I'm not that interested in theater."|227|0
units.english: "I'm not that interested in theater."
units.italian: "Il teatro non mi interessa più di tanto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stage Play|	"Thou wouldst surely be a well-treated guest," the Successor says. "Follow me, and we shan't be late."|229|0
units.english: "Thou wouldst surely be a well-treated guest," the Successor says. "Follow me, and we shan't be late."
units.italian: "Saresti di certo un ospite ben trattato", dice il Successore. "Seguimi, e non faremo tardi."
